name: Devushka v Zerkale
source:
The protagonist, Buki, moves into his late grandfather's mansion and finds a mysterious mirror in which the girl lives.

[From [url=https://troyholman.itch.io/girl-in-the-mirror]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
主角布基搬进已故祖父的宅邸，发现了一面神秘的镜子，里面住着一位少女。

[摘自[url=https://troyholman.itch.io/girl-in-the-mirror]itch.io[/url]]
